title: Family time at home
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Mondd el, mit látsz a képeken, hasonlítsd össze őket, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire a saját családodról.

scenes.description: A big family is having Sunday lunch in the garden of a house in a village. Three generations are sitting at a long wooden table: the grandparents, two parents and four children of different ages. The grandmother is bringing a large pot of soup, and a little boy is feeding the dog under the table. Everyone is laughing and the sun is shining.

A father and his teenage daughter are doing housework in a small flat in a big city. The father is ironing shirts in front of the TV, and the girl is vacuuming the living room with headphones on. There is a basket of clean washing on the sofa and a shopping list on the fridge. They both look a little tired, but the girl is singing along to her music.

prompts: Who are the people and what are they doing?
How are the two family situations different?
Which picture is closer to your family's life? Why?
followUpQuestions: Does your family often eat together? When?
Who does most of the housework in your home?
Which household job do you hate the most? Why?
Do you think children should help at home? How much?
What does your family do when relatives visit?
